limits: This review approves the evidence framing and finite original test replay, not a production or whole-backend security profile.

Host-controlled traffic quiescence through activation commit, fresh trusted private executor and quiescent administrative DDL remain premises. The client census alone does not exclude later connections.
The separately raised external-trigger to internal SECURITY DEFINER effect path is not demonstrated or disproved by these four methods; no complete callable/effect-closure claim follows.
No general COUNT, graph/raw-table, aggregate, actor/backend, concurrency, live migration, output-lifetime or publication-drain acceptance is supplied.

Wheel, child, PostgreSQL binary and selected source hashes plus environment versions are not a complete transitive executable/runtime attestation; Bun/Python and every dependency binary are not independently pinned here. Before/after observations do not prove hostile transient-replacement exclusion.
